consequence.statement: portLevelSettings configurations in DestinationRules for waypoints will now be applied, whereas they were previously ignored; environments relying on workarounds or expecting this field to be ineffective should verify that the now-honored settings produce the desired traffic behavior.

original.statement: portLevelSettings in DestinationRules for waypoints are now honored instead of being ignored.

decision.reason: [ev-a3e90b78f6fa] says a bug that made `portLevelSettings` in DestinationRules for waypoints get ignored has been fixed. After the upgrade those settings take effect. Nothing fails, gets rejected or stops being honoured; it is the other way round. So waypoint traffic may simply behave differently, which makes behavior-change (review) the right kind. The evidence does not support an action-eligible kind.
